variants.specifics: Brackenford: Halvard wants the tithe chest Corwin's men stole back unopened; Sly Wat sells a back way into the watchtower.

offer_a.speaker: Halvard
offer_a.text:
One more matter, stranger. When Corwin's men raided the Chapel of the Ford, they carried off the tithe chest as well. That chest holds the tithes of the whole town!

If you should find it up on Crow Hill, bring it back to me unopened. I will see that you are well rewarded.

offer_b.speaker: Wat
offer_b.text:
Psst! You there! Goin' up the hill, are ye? Heh, heh... Thought so.

I used to run with Corwin, see, till he caught me eatin' his cheese. I know a back way into that old tower that nobody guards. It's yours for 30 gold. What d'you say?

outcome_a.speaker: Halvard
outcome_a.text:
The tithe chest! Splendid, splendid! The Chapel shall have its tithes and Brackenford its winter stores.

Please accept this shield with the thanks of the whole town.

outcome_b.speaker: Wat
outcome_b.text: You made it out! Told ye that cellar door was never locked, didn't I? Heh, heh... Have a drink on old Wat!

journal_a.text: Recover the stolen tithe chest for Halvard.

journal_b.text: Use Sly Wat's back way into the watchtower.

variants.specifics: Kroth: Priest Odo of the Shrine of Stone wants the holy braziers below relit against the Undead; Snig, a sneak in the Molehole, wants his hidden cask of Mountain Brew fetched from the Rat Run.

offer_a.speaker: Odo
offer_a.text:
Greetings, my son. The holy braziers in the Old Deeps have gone out. Without their flames, nothing stands between Ulgrim's Undead and the town.

Take this torch and light the three braziers beyond the Deep Gate. The Shrine of Stone will not forget such a valiant service.

offer_b.speaker: Snig
offer_b.text:
Psst! Hey, you! Yeah, you. You look like somebody who goes places other folks won't.

I had a little cask of Mountain Brew hidden down in the Rat Run, see. Very rare. Very valuable. Then the Zombies moved in.

Fetch it for me and I'll give you a fine sword. Never been used! Well... hardly.

outcome_a.speaker: Odo
outcome_a.text: The braziers burn again! I felt it in my bones! Kroth owes you a great debt, my son. Accept this gold from the Shrine, with my blessing.

outcome_b.speaker: Snig
outcome_b.text: Heh, heh, heh! My cask! Here's yer sword, like I said. Now go on, before somebody sees us together!

journal_a.text: Light the three holy braziers in the Old Deeps.

journal_b.text: Fetch Snig's cask of Mountain Brew from the Rat Run.

variants.specifics: Gloam: Ysolde the Healer needs Blackroot from the Zombie-haunted east isle for the bitten sick; Mudge, an odd skull collector, trades a Steel Shield for a Zombie skull.

offer_a.speaker: Ysolde the Healer
offer_a.text:
Greetings, Wanderer. The Healing House is full of the sick. Many were bitten by the Undead, and their wounds will not close.

I can mend them with Blackroot, but it grows on the isle east of the village, and the Zombies roam there now. Bring me a sack of Blackroot and I will offer a worthy reward.

offer_b.speaker: Mudge
offer_b.text:
Heh, heh, heh... You look like somebody who ain't scared of a Zombie or two. I got a little business offer for you.

I collect skulls, see. Undead ones! Bring me the skull of a Zombie, a nice fresh one, and this shiny Steel Shield is all yours. Deal?

outcome_a.speaker: Ysolde the Healer
outcome_a.text: The Blackroot! Thank goodness! Now I can tend to the sick at last. Please, take this gold. Gloam will not forget what you have done.

outcome_b.speaker: Mudge
outcome_b.text: Ooooh! Look at him! Look at that grin! Heh, heh, heh... He goes right up on the shelf with the others. Here's your shield, friend. Pleasure doing business!

journal_a.text: Gather Blackroot for Ysolde the Healer.

journal_b.text: Bring Mudge the skull of a Zombie.

variants.specifics: Durnhelm: Commander Holgrim wants the garrison's pay chest back from the Skeletons; Lumpy Dorn, in the keep's cells, trades the hiding place of a shield for a meat pie.

offer_a.speaker: Commander Holgrim
offer_a.text:
A grave matter, lad. Our supply wagon was ambushed on the moor road and the pay chest for the whole garrison was lost with it. Those abominable Skeletons stand guard over the wreck, east of the gate.

Soldiers without pay are surly soldiers. Recover the chest and the Iron Watch will see you well rewarded.

offer_b.speaker: Lumpy Dorn
offer_b.text:
Psst! You! Over here by the bars!

The Commander threw me in here for borrowing a shield. Borrowing! I was going to give it back!

Tell you what. Bring me a meat pie from the Broken Pike and I'll tell you where I hid it. Do we have a deal?

outcome_a.speaker: Commander Holgrim
outcome_a.text: The pay chest! Splendid work! The men will be paid tonight. Take these 100 gold pieces from it, with the thanks of the Iron Watch.

outcome_b.speaker: Lumpy Dorn
outcome_b.text: A pie! Mmmmf... Oh, that's a good pie. All right, a deal's a deal. The shield's under the hay in the stables. Don't tell the Commander! Heh, heh, heh...

journal_a.text: Recover the garrison's pay chest from the wrecked supply wagon.

journal_b.text: Bring Lumpy Dorn a meat pie from the Broken Pike.

variants.specifics: Ostra: Master Ferrin wants the old beacon on Heron Point lit so the boats can come home; Snibbet wants his taxed barrel of cider stolen back out of the storehouse.

offer_a.speaker: Master Ferrin
offer_a.text:
Greetings, Wanderer. These are dark days for Ostra. Since the Necromancer seized the lighthouse on Gorm Isle, our boats come home blind in the fog, and the rocks have taken more than one.

There is an old beacon on Heron Point, along the shore west of here. If it were lit, our fishermen could find their way home.

Light it, and I shall see that you are well rewarded.

offer_b.speaker: Snibbet
offer_b.text:
Psst! Hey! Over here, friend! You look like a fella who can keep his mouth shut.

Master Ferrin's men took a barrel of my best cider right off my boat. Taxes, he says! Ha! It's sitting in the storehouse on the long pier.

Fetch it back for me, quiet-like, and I'll give you a nice shiny sword. Deal?

outcome_a.speaker: Master Ferrin
outcome_a.text:
The beacon burns! Look there -- the boats are coming in! Ostra owes you a great debt, Wanderer. Take this shield as a token of our thanks.

Now go and see Mayor Odrick. He has need of you.

outcome_b.speaker: Snibbet
outcome_b.text: Ha, ha! My cider! You're a true pal! Here's the sword, like I promised. Don't go telling Ferrin where you got it. Heh, heh, heh...

journal_a.text: Light the old beacon on Heron Point for Master Ferrin.

journal_b.text: Take Snibbet's barrel of cider from the storehouse on the long pier.

variants.specifics: Ardoth: Magistrate Tullan wants to know what became of his watchmen on the mill road; Nubbin, locked in the lockup for turning Tullan's hat into a goose, trades a back way into the Star Tower for his freedom.

offer_a.speaker: Tullan
offer_a.text:
Good day, young sir. You look capable enough.

It is my unhappy duty to tell you that I sent a patrol of watchmen down the mill road, south of town, to see what the Necromancer's creatures were up to. Not one of them has returned.

Find out what became of my men. Your assistance would be most appreciated, and the town will reward you handsomely.

offer_b.speaker: Nubbin
offer_b.text:
Psst! Hey, you! Over here, by the bars!

They locked me up just for turning Magistrate Tullan's hat into a goose. It was a very small goose!

Get the key off the hook by the jailer's desk and let me out. Do that, and I'll show you a back way into the Star Tower that Malgor doesn't know about. Heh, heh, heh... Deal?

outcome_a.speaker: Tullan
outcome_a.text:
Dead? All of them? This is a black day for Ardoth... Malgor will answer for this!

You have done the town a great service, young sir. Please, accept this as a token of our gratitude. And go to Archmaster Quellan at once. He must hear of this.

outcome_b.speaker: Nubbin
outcome_b.text: Free! Free at last! Thanks, friend. The back way into the Star Tower is through the old well behind it. Malgor never had it filled in. Now I'm off, before the jailer wakes up!

journal_a.text: Find out what became of Magistrate Tullan's watchmen on the mill road.

journal_b.text: Get the jail key and free Nubbin from the lockup.

variants.specifics: Fort Skarn: Brother Ennick wants the risen dead in the chapel crypt put down; Nibbs, locked up for cheating at dice, wants the jailer's key.

offer_a.speaker: Brother Ennick
offer_a.text:
Greetings, my son. Grave tidings, I fear. Kolgrath's foul magic has reached even into our chapel. The honored dead in the crypt below have risen from their rest!

I am a man of prayer, not of the sword. Go down into the crypt and lay them to rest again, and the chapel will see you rewarded.

offer_b.speaker: Nibbs
offer_b.text:
Psst! You there! Yes, you! Come closer.

They locked me up for one little game of dice. Can you believe it? The jailer keeps the key on his belt, and he sleeps through his whole watch.

Bring me that key and I'll tell you where I buried a real beauty of a Longsword. What do you say?

outcome_a.speaker: Brother Ennick
outcome_a.text: The dead sleep again! Bless you, my son. This shield has hung in our chapel for many years. Take it, and may it guard you against Kolgrath's evil.

outcome_b.speaker: Nibbs
outcome_b.text: Hee, hee! Free at last! The Longsword is under the woodpile behind the stable, like I said. And if the Warden asks, you never saw me!

journal_a.text: Destroy the Undead in the crypt beneath the chapel.

journal_b.text: Steal the cell key from the sleeping jailer and free Nibbs.

variants.specifics: Vulmar: Guildmaster Orvald wants the jammed lava sluice west of town opened; Grubb the scrapper sells a chain tunic of doubtful origin.

offer_a.speaker: Guildmaster Orvald
offer_a.text:
Greetings, Wanderer. The Ogres have jammed the great lava sluice west of town. Without the lava, our furnaces languish and the Guild cannot arm the town against these abominable brutes.

Go to the sluice and pull the great lever. The Guild will reward you handsomely.

offer_b.speaker: Grubb
offer_b.text:
Psst! You there! Need some armor? I got a chain tunic here, hardly used. It fell in the lava twice and didn't even melt!

Yours for 100 gold. Can't say fairer than that, eh?

outcome_a.speaker: Guildmaster Orvald
outcome_a.text:
The lava flows again! Listen to those hammers ring! The Guild is in your debt, lad. Take this longsword, fresh from our own forge.

Now go and see Mayor Dravik. The Ogres will not like this one bit!

outcome_b.speaker: Grubb
outcome_b.text: Sold! Pleasure doing business with you, friend. And if the Mayor's men come asking, you never saw me.

journal_a.text: Open the lava sluice west of Vulmar for Guildmaster Orvald.

journal_b.text: Buy the chain tunic from Grubb for 100 gold.

variants.specifics: Kesrin: Brother Calvo wants the Ghost in the Broken Wheel's attic banished; Gimble, locked in the stocks for stealing a pig, offers his buried sword to be let out.

offer_a.speaker: Brother Calvo
offer_a.text:
Bless you for coming, stranger! A Ghost has taken up lodging in the attic of the Broken Wheel. It moans all night and throws the plates about.

Bodger fears he will lose what little custom he has left. I fear it is yet another sign of Ravek's wicked work.

Will you go up and banish it?

offer_b.speaker: Gimble
offer_b.text:
Psst... over here! No, here, in the stocks!

Mayor Fennick locked me up for one little pig. One! And it was only Ossrik's.

Dalt has the key on his belt. Get me out of here and I'll tell you where I buried my sword. Whatcha say?

outcome_a.speaker: Brother Calvo
outcome_a.text: The Ghost is gone? Praise be! The Broken Wheel is saved! Take this shield, kind sir, and may it guard you well against Ravek's foul Undead!

outcome_b.speaker: Gimble
outcome_b.text: Free! Ahhh, my poor legs... A deal's a deal. Dig under the big stump behind the Broken Wheel. The sword's yours, and there's a bit of coin with it. Heh, heh, heh... Now you never saw me!

journal_a.text: Banish the Ghost from the attic of the Broken Wheel.

journal_b.text: Get Dalt's key and free Gimble from the stocks.

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Warden Dalbrek wants the village's seed corn back from the Ogres; Mungo the scarecrow-maker wants an Ogre's helmet for his scarecrow.

offer_a.speaker: Dalbrek
offer_a.text:
Good day to you, kind sir. You have the look of one who can handle himself.

The Ogres have stolen the village's seed corn and carried it off toward Kragmoor. Without seed there can be no planting in the spring, and without planting, Ostrel will starve.

Recover it, and the village will see you handsomely rewarded.

offer_b.speaker: Mungo
offer_b.text:
Psst! Hey! Over here! You want to be rid of them Ogres? I've built the scariest scarecrow in the whole valley. Only he needs a proper Ogre helmet on his head to finish him off.

Bring me a helmet off one of them Ogres and I'll give you this Longsword. Found it in a ditch. Hardly used! Heh, heh, heh...

outcome_a.speaker: Dalbrek
outcome_a.text: The seed corn! Splendid! Ostrel is in your debt, brave Adventurer. Please, take this Chain Tunic from the village armory. You have more than earned it.

outcome_b.speaker: Mungo
outcome_b.text: Ha! A real Ogre helmet! Look at him now -- the meanest scarecrow in all of Nox! The Ogres will run home crying to their mothers! Here's your sword. A deal's a deal!

journal_a.text: Recover the seed corn the Ogres stole and return it to Warden Dalbrek.

journal_b.text: Bring Mungo a helmet taken from an Ogre.
